title.narrative: Accelerating Indonesias Clean Energy Transition (AICET) - Phase 1 (RBL)
Accelerating Indonesias Clean Energy Transition (AICET) - Phase 1 (RBL)

description.narrative: Accelerating Indonesias Clean Energy Transition (AICET) is a result-based lending (RBL) financed by ADB and co-financed by KfW and AFD. AICET supports Indonesia in achieving its Net Zero Emissions (NZE) targets by facilitating the countrys clean energy transition through three key focus areas: (i) facilitating the transition to renewable clean electricity supply in partnership with the private sector by fostering solar and wind power generation connected to the grid, (ii) strengthening power grid infrastructure for renewable energy integration by upgrading substation transformer capacities and modernizing transmission control centers, and (iii) enhancing PLN institutional capacity to manage just energy transition by implementing robust environmental and social safeguards, upskilling PLN staff, and promoting gender equality in renewable energy roles. The program is executed by Indonesias state-owned electricity, PT PLN (Persero). The implementation structure of the RBL program is based on the achievement of specific results, on which the disbursement of funds is based. The achievement of objectives is reviewed annually by an independent verification consultant. The disbursement of the funds is linked to the achievement of clearly measurable success indicators or known as disbursement-linked indicators (DLIs). The main goals are to reduce climate-relevant emissions, accelerate the expansion of renewable energies and strengthen the network and institute infrastructure. A special focus is placed on the involvement of the private sector and increasing the proportion of women in relevant fields of employment at PLN.

Der RBL AICET unterstützt den staatlichen Energieversorger PLN durch einen dreigliedrigen Ansatz dabei, die Energiewende in Indonesien zu beschleunigen und auf die Zielsetzungen der Just Energy Transition Partnership (JETP) einzuzahlen. Konkrete Maßnahmen werden erstens im Ausbau von Erneuerbaren Energieträgern, zweitens im Auf- und Ausbau intelligenter Stromnetze und drittens durch die Mobilisierung des Privatsektors adressiert.

Accelerating Indonesias Clean Energy Transition (AICET) is a result-based lending (RBL) financed by ADB and co-financed by KfW and AFD. AICET supports Indonesia in achieving its Net Zero Emissions (NZE) targets by facilitating the countrys clean energy transition through three key focus areas: (i) facilitating the transition to renewable clean electricity supply in partnership with the private sector by fostering solar and wind power generation connected to the grid, (ii) strengthening power grid infrastructure for renewable energy integration by upgrading substation transformer capacities and modernizing transmission control centers, and (iii) enhancing PLN institutional capacity to manage just energy transition by implementing robust environmental and social safeguards, upskilling PLN staff, and promoting gender equality in renewable energy roles. The program is executed by Indonesias state-owned electricity, PT PLN (Persero). The implementation structure of the RBL program is based on the achievement of specific results, on which the disbursement of funds is based. The achievement of objectives is reviewed annually by an independent verification consultant. The disbursement of the funds is linked to the achievement of clearly measurable success indicators or known as disbursement-linked indicators (DLIs). The main goals are to reduce climate-relevant emissions, accelerate the expansion of renewable energies and strengthen the network and institute infrastructure. Die Ergebnisbasierte Finanzierung Accelerating Indonesia´s Clean Energy Transition (AICET RBL) unterstützt den staatlichen Energieversorger PT PLN dabei, die Energieversorgung auf Erneuerbare Energie umzustellen. Wie bei ergebnisbasierten Finanzierungen üblich, werden Auszahlungen in Abhängigkeit von Zielerreichung von Erfolgsindikatoren (sog. Disbursement Linked Indicators, DLI) bewilligt. DLIs des AICET RBL zielen unter anderem auf quantifizierbare Ziele ab, beispielsweise die kumulative Einspeisung erneuerbarer Energie in die verschiedenen Verteilnetze. AICET RBL wird in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der ADB (Asiatische Entwicklungsbank) und Agence Française De Développement (AFD) konzipiert und durchgeführt. AICET RBL soll auch dazu beitragen, dass sich die Privatsektorbeteiligung im Energiesektor in den nächsten Jahren erhöht. PLN plant einen Großteil der zu finanzierenden Solar PV und Wind Projekte in Joint-Ventures (JV) umzusetzen. Hiervon verspricht die Regierung Indonesiens eine personelle Entlastung auf Seiten der PLN und agilere Umsetzung von Projekten im Energiesektor.
